title: PluginEvals
description: An eval suite a plugin ships for one of its agents, a file of `contents.evals` (ADR 0093, ADR 0020). Level 1 is the shape of the core catalogue's `eval_cases/` (`choregos_core.catalogue_d_agents.evals`): the agent's rendered instructions, lower-cased, hold every `must_contain` and no `must_not_contain`; the installer refuses a plugin whose own suite fails. `cases` are in the `AgentEvalCase` shape of the API (S32-03, S40-02d): a deterministic one (`live: false`) is played by the installer on its sample input; a `live` one is validated, never run at install.

live.description: a capped trial on the real model that asserts on the run's result (S40-02d)

agent.description: the slug of an agent the same plugin ships

must_contain.description: level 1: what the rendered instructions must hold (case-insensitive)

must_not_contain.description: level 1: what they must never hold (case-insensitive)

inputs.description: the template inputs the instructions are rendered with

production_indicators.description: what the project can measure in production, for the rendering (S22-48)

min_score.description: the share of `must_contain` that must be found
